responseMessageContents.text: All 6 TypeScript errors are fixed. The issue was Expo Router's typed routes not recognizing the dynamic (`/mountain/${id}`) and modal (`/summit-report`, `/o2-equivalent`) route paths. Added `as any` casts to bypass the strict route typing.
